answer: A workable design: bind a hardware-attested enclave quote to the identity key at join time. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the forge to sunk effort, uses the pearl as an corroborating signal, then requires a sparrow before any payout.
